description: Parse SysML v2 / KerML documents as one model and return its modelHash, the root namespace of each document and every diagnostic (the ParseSources RPC). Parsing is content-addressed: the same documents give the same modelHash, and the hash is what every other runtime tool takes as modelHash, so parse once and pass the hash, or give those tools the same paths/sources and they parse implicitly. A model is only readable when no diagnostic has severity error. The result is the ParseSourcesResponse as protojson writes it; the text lists each root and the diagnostics as the CLI prints them.

baseModelHash.description: the modelHash of an earlier parse of these documents; the answer's affected then lists the documents whose results may differ from it

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root; a name declared in one resolves in the others

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

name: parse
